description: Renders a specific frame from a DICOM instance to an image format. Requires Study, Series, and SOP Instance UIDs from find-instances, and a frame number. Returns the rendered image as a base64-encoded string.

frame.description: 1-based index of the frame to render (e.g., 1 for the first frame)

outputFormat.description: Desired MIME type for the rendered output (e.g., image/jpeg)

seriesInstanceUid.description: DICOM Series Instance UID (e.g., 1.2.840.113619.2.55.3.604688123). Obtain from find-series.

sopInstanceUid.description: DICOM SOP Instance UID (e.g., 1.2.840.113619.2.55.3.604688123.123.1591781234.469). Obtain from find-instances.

studyInstanceUid.description: DICOM Study Instance UID (e.g., 1.2.840.113619.2.55.3). Obtain from find-studies.

name: render-instance-frame
